[RDSC.7.2.1] "per module" means at most one atom per
`module_id` value (`DsSource`) or one per (module_id, named
entity) pair (every other per-module atom). The compiler
must write no duplicate within a module's namespace, and the
runtime does not check for one ([RDSC.7.2]). A schema's own name
([LIMP.13.1]), a rule's name ([LGRA.6.8]) and a service's name ([LCRS.14.9])
are each unique in a program, so the compiler must write no two
`schema_group`s of one name, no two `rule_group`s of one rule and no two
`ServiceDef`s of one service. No atom of one module replaces an atom of another.
